_comment: Curated event cards. To add an event, copy a block below and fill it in. Fields: tile = tailgate | pregame | watch | generic (picks the card image); type = short label shown on the image; badge = optional pill like 'No ticket needed'; url = the ORIGINAL public listing/post the button opens; source = short name of that site shown on the button.

events.title: Braai Army supporters block + TailGOAT tailgate
events.description: The official Springbok supporters group: a 650-seat supporters block inside the ground and a full pre-match tailgate outside — braai fires, drinks, music, gees. Already ticketed? Their “Commando” option covers just the social.

events.title: Gameday Firehouse pregame
events.where: 1202 Ridgely St — steps from the stadium
events.description: A converted firehouse turned sports bar right beside the ground, opening early for the match. Food, drinks, and traveling fans from everywhere before the short walk to the gates.

events.title: UCT Alumni & Friends watch party
events.when: Match time — arrive early for a seat
events.where: One Star Country Club, 38 E Cross St, Federal Hill
events.description: University of Cape Town alumni host a watch party in Federal Hill — food and drinks for purchase, SA expats and friends welcome. If you couldn’t get a seat, this is the room with the gees.
